what_it_is: TF-IDF words + a BGE meaning model fine-tuned on our labels (with extra negation examples), 7 yes/no judges, a confidence gate, and a rule that sends negation questions (not / except / skip) to the LLM
why: Best of 8 models tried: most accurate on normal questions and the cheapest full system. A bigger fine-tuned model (Laya) was only a tie in the full system and 8x slower.
